About me

My approach

I’ve always been curious about the why behind things, and that curiosity shapes how I approach design.

My research background taught me to look deeper, understand people, and connect insights to meaningful solutions. I enjoy bringing research, interaction, and visual design together to create experiences that feel intuitive and purposeful.

Lately

I’m exploring AR/VR and spatial interactions, designing for space, not just screens.

Off screen

You’ll find me reading, painting, cooking or exploring fashion.
